content_sections.heading: Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to attend the walk-in interview for SCTIMST Technician Apprentice in Computer Engineering Recruitment 2026 should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the organization conducting this recruitment?
faq.answer: This recruitment is being conducted by Sree Chitra Tirunal Institute for Medical Sciences and Technology (SCTIMST), located in Thiruvananthapuram, Kerala.

faq.question: Q2. What is the name of the post available in SCTIMST Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The available post is Technician Apprentice in Computer Engineering under temporary research field employment.

faq.question: Q3. How many vacancies are available for this recruitment?
faq.answer: There are a total of 6 vacancies available for the Technician Apprentice in Computer Engineering position.

faq.question: Q4. What is the required educational qualification for the post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a Diploma in Computer Engineering from a recognized institution to be eligible for this position.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for SCTIMST Technician Apprentice Recruitment?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for applicants is 35 years as per the official recruitment notification.

faq.question: Q6. What is the monthly salary/stipend offered?
faq.answer: Selected candidates for the Technician Apprentice in Computer Engineering position will receive a monthly salary of 10,900/- per month.

faq.question: Q7. What is the mode of application and selection?
faq.answer: The application mode is Walk-in, and selection involves a written test (depending on the number of candidates) followed by a walk-in interview.

faq.question: Q8. When is the walk-in interview scheduled?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview is scheduled to take place on 15-10-2026. Candidates should report on time.

faq.question: Q9. Is there any application fee required?
faq.answer: No application fee is mentioned in the official notification for attending the walk-in interview.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I find the official website and notification details?
faq.answer: You can check the official website at www.sctimst.ac.in or read the official notification PDF for complete details and updates.
